nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Entry point. POST from NestJS with the envelope {runId, ownerId, jobId, agentId, payload}. Checks the X-Agora-Secret header and answers 200 at once; the work continues in the background.

nodes.name: Read envelope
nodes.notes: Takes the request body and flattens envelope + payload into one item, so later nodes can read $('Read envelope').first().json.jobId and friends. Stops if runId is missing.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Reads the three reviewer model ids (use different models for independence).

parameters.query:
SELECT d.id AS delivery_id, d.commit_sha, d.repo_url, d.attempt,
       m.idx AS milestone_idx, m.job_id, j.base_commit, j.buyer_id,
       a.test_command, a.build_command, a.failing_tests, a.allowed_paths,
       a.test_files, a.spec_hash, a.locked_at,
       (SELECT id FROM agents WHERE role = 'reviewer'
         ORDER BY label OFFSET ($2::int - 1) LIMIT 1) AS reviewer_agent_id
FROM deliveries d
JOIN milestones m ON m.id = d.milestone_id
JOIN jobs j ON j.id = m.job_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT * FROM acceptance_specs s
   WHERE s.job_id = j.id AND s.locked_at IS NOT NULL
   ORDER BY s.version DESC LIMIT 1) a ON true
WHERE d.id = $1::uuid;

nodes.name: Load delivery
nodes.notes: Delivery, milestone, base commit, the LOCKED spec and this reviewer's agent id.

nodes.name: Prepare run
nodes.notes: Picks the reviewer's style, model and signer (reviewer-1/2/3) and the runner input.

nodes.name: Run tests
nodes.notes: Runs the locked tests on the delivered commit in a throwaway container.

nodes.name: Required checks
nodes.notes: Code decides: locked spec, builds, tests pass, scope (allowed paths), tests untouched, no planted instructions in the diff or log.

nodes.name: Build prompt
nodes.notes: Asks the model for advisory notes and a 'suspicious' flag. Diff and log are untrusted.

nodes.name: Ask LLM
nodes.notes: Calls the lib llm-json sub-workflow: one model call that must return a JSON object with the required keys, or the run fails.

nodes.name: Decide
nodes.notes: approve = all required checks pass AND not suspicious. The model can only veto.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO reviewer_votes
  (delivery_id, reviewer_agent_id, approve, check_results, log_hash, log_path,
   attestation_hash, model, duration_ms)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::boolean, $4::jsonb, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9::int)
ON CONFLICT (delivery_id, reviewer_agent_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;

nodes.name: Save vote
nodes.notes: Inserts reviewer_votes with log hash, attestation hash and model. One vote per reviewer per delivery.

nodes.name: Vote args
nodes.notes: Builds the vote call for this reviewer's vote-only key.

nodes.name: Chain call
nodes.notes: Calls lib chain-call, the only door to NEAR. Mock mode checks the mandate in the database; testnet mode signs with the right limited key.

nodes.name: Save vote tx
nodes.notes: Stores the vote transaction hash on the vote row.

nodes.name: Finish
nodes.notes: Builds one item with the feed message for agent_events and the 'notify' body for NestJS. Messages are written for the owner to read.

nodes.name: Log event
nodes.notes: Calls lib log-event: inserts the row into agent_events (the live activity feed).

nodes.name: Notify Nest
nodes.notes: Calls lib notify-nest: POST /agents/notify so NestJS moves the job to its next step. Errors are ignored, so the agent still works while Nest is not built.
